review.method: Verified the old and regenerated SHA-256 values for every changedFrames row against the P6 snapshot and committed P7 screenshots, then inspected every comparison record and grouped the 243 formerly generic rows by their concrete P6 semantic-weight owner. All 243 rows pass their recorded pixel thresholds and the catalog semantics match exactly. The program-editor Add-glyph disposition is restricted to the 21 frames where that action is visibly inside the viewport; the two clipped Build frames are assigned only to the semibold group. The remaining eight common rows already carry their specific proposal-identifier rationale, and the eight added frames have their paused-timer rationale.

reviewDispositions.semanticRole: Typography emphasis weight owned by the frozen --weight-semibold token (600).
reviewDispositions.cause: At P6 source SHA 65edbc6d428bfa18bd77eabe8bde789e26737580, the listed live text owners were migrated from literal font-weight values 640, 650, or 700 to var(--weight-semibold). The live Plex Sans face is variable from weight 100 through 700, so the migration changes rendered glyph strokes to the contract weight 600. The complete frame set is exactly the set of common P6-to-P7 frames carrying the earlier generic same-source rationale.
reviewDispositions.visualOutcome: Affected emphasized text now renders at the frozen semibold weight. The rendered copy, semantic state, action availability, and hierarchy are unchanged; reviewed comparisons showed no line-wrap or control-geometry change. Every listed frame has its own old/new SHA-256 and comparator metrics in changedFrames; all 243 passed the fixed perceptual thresholds and the catalog semantic comparison is exact.

evidence.fontFace: styles.css: Plex Sans variable face declares font-weight: 100 700

reviewDispositions.cause: At P6 source SHA 65edbc6d428bfa18bd77eabe8bde789e26737580, .program-editor__add span changed from literal font-weight: 300 to var(--weight-regular), whose frozen value is 400.
reviewDispositions.visualOutcome: Only frames where the Add action is visibly inside the viewport are included. Its plus glyph uses the frozen regular weight; the action, target, label, and placement remain present and unchanged. The two clipped Build frames remain linked only to the shared semibold disposition. All 21 listed frames pass fixed perceptual thresholds.
